shortDescription: DeFiLlama data showed that Solana ecosystem Launchpad StonkFun generated $1.84 million in revenue over the past 24 hours, ranking third among protocols tracked by DeFiLlama. According to Odaily, it trailed only Tether at $16.58 million and Circle at $6.77 million.

title: Solana Ecosystem Launchpad StonkFun Ranks Third in 24-Hour Revenue on DeFiLlama
